question.text: Preparation of potassium permanganate from $\mathrm{MnO}_2$ involves two step process in which the 1st step is a reaction with KOH and $\mathrm{KNO}_3$ to produce

solution.text:
Preparation of $\mathrm{KMnO}{ }_4$
$\mathrm{MnO}_2 \xrightarrow[\mathrm{KNO}_3]{\mathrm{KOH}} \mathrm{K}_2 \mathrm{MnO}_4 \xrightarrow[\substack{\text { Oxidation in } \\ \text { Alkaline solution }}]{\text { Elecrolta }} \mathrm{KMnO}_4$
